candidates.intent: Submit a document and generate a Turnitin Similarity Report via the Turnitin Core API (TCA).
candidates.input_contract: submission (file/text) plus metadata, then generate-report request
candidates.output_contract: submission id, similarity score, and report viewer URL
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot itself compute a defensible similarity/originality score against Turnitin's corpus.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authoritative plagiarism-detection scores from the dominant academic-integrity corpus.
candidates.verify_note: Requires per-institution Turnitin URL + API key. Submitting student work invokes FERPA + academic-integrity duties; never auto-conclude misconduct.

candidates.intent: Post a score to a platform gradebook line item via LTI Advantage Assignment & Grade Services (AGS).
candidates.input_contract: lineitem URL + Score object (userId, scoreGiven, scoreMaximum, activityProgress, gradingProgress)
candidates.output_contract: score acceptance acknowledgement per LTI AGS spec
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot write a grade back into an arbitrary LMS gradebook without the standardized AGS flow.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides a vendor-neutral, OAuth2-scoped path to post scores to any LTI-Advantage LMS.
candidates.verify_note: Writes official grades across LMS vendors — approval-gate; requires signed JWT client assertion + AGS scope. FERPA-critical.

candidates.intent: Read the roster (users + roles) for an LTI context via Names and Role Provisioning Services (NRPS).
candidates.input_contract: context memberships URL plus optional role/limit query params
candidates.output_contract: membership container with members[] (user_id, roles, name, email per privacy)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot obtain a course roster from an arbitrary LMS without the standardized NRPS flow.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides a vendor-neutral authoritative roster (even for users who never launched the tool).
candidates.verify_note: Returns roster PII subject to platform privacy settings — FERPA; honor name/email suppression; OAuth2 NRPS scope required.

candidates.intent: Return selected content items to an LMS via the LTI Advantage Deep Linking response (signed JWT).
candidates.input_contract: deep-linking settings + ContentItem[] (ltiResourceLink, file, html) signed as JWT
candidates.output_contract: auto-posted deep-linking response message accepted by the platform
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot register selected tool content back into an LMS course without the Deep Linking handshake.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides a standardized signed mechanism to place chosen resources into any LTI-Advantage course.
candidates.verify_note: Requires correctly signed JWT with platform keys; misconfigured claims fail silently. Content placement is course-affecting.

candidates.intent: Parse/exchange a QTI assessment item or test package (XML) per the 1EdTech QTI 3.0 spec.
candidates.input_contract: QTI 3.0 XML item/test (assessmentItem, responseDeclaration, itemBody)
candidates.output_contract: structured item model (interactions, correct responses, scoring rules)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably round-trip standardized assessment items across authoring/delivery tools without the QTI schema.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides deterministic, schema-validated import/export of real assessment content between systems.
candidates.verify_note: QTI is an XML interop spec (not a hosted API); validation is deterministic but answer keys are exam-integrity sensitive.

candidates.intent: Generate a Proctorio proctored-exam launch URL for a candidate (LTI/API integration).
candidates.input_contract: exam config + candidate identity (display_name, user_id, roster_url)
candidates.output_contract: signed launch URL initiating the proctored session
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot initiate a proctored exam session with valid signing on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides a deterministic, signed proctored-session launch tied to candidate identity.
candidates.verify_note: Proctoring involves biometric/behavioral monitoring of students — high privacy/FERPA and consent sensitivity; surveillance ethics review advised.

candidates.intent: Schedule or manage a live/recorded proctored exam session via the ProctorU API.
candidates.input_contract: exam id + candidate + time window per ProctorU API
candidates.output_contract: session/reservation object with id, status, scheduled time
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reserve a human/AI-proctored exam slot without the platform API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic scheduling and status reads for proctored assessments.
candidates.verify_note: Candidate PII + monitoring — FERPA/consent sensitive; requires ProctorU API credentials.

candidates.intent: Search WorldCat and retrieve bibliographic records via the OCLC WorldCat Search API 2.0.
candidates.input_contract: query (keyword, ISBN, ISSN, OCLC number) plus paging
candidates.output_contract: bibliographic records (JSON) with title, authors, identifiers, format
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate or verify records in the world's largest union catalog without the live API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authoritative bibliographic lookups with real OCLC numbers and citations from WorldCat.
candidates.verify_note: Requires OCLC API key (WSKey/OAuth2). Bibliographic metadata is largely non-PII; institutional entitlement applies.

candidates.intent: Find which libraries hold an item (by OCLC number/ISBN) via the WorldCat Search/Discovery API.
candidates.input_contract: identifier (OCLC number/ISBN) plus optional location radius
candidates.output_contract: holdings/library records indicating which institutions hold the item
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know which libraries currently hold a given item without the live holdings API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative holdings data for interlibrary-loan and availability workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Requires OCLC API key. Holdings are institutional metadata, not PII.

candidates.intent: Read or write WorldCat bibliographic / local holdings records via the WorldCat Metadata API 2.0.
candidates.input_contract: OCLC number for read; MARC/JSON record for create/update of bib or LHR
candidates.output_contract: bibliographic or local-holdings record (JSON/MARC) with status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot maintain a library's authoritative catalog records in WorldCat by itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides deterministic read/write of real bib + local holdings data with OAuth2.
candidates.verify_note: Writes mutate shared cataloging data — approval-gate; requires Metadata API entitlement (cataloging subscription).

candidates.intent: Retrieve an Ex Libris Alma bibliographic record (with availability) via the Alma BIBs API.
candidates.input_contract: mms_id plus optional expand (p_avail, e_avail, d_avail)
candidates.output_contract: bib record (MARCXML) with holdings/electronic/digital availability
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read an academic library's live catalog record or availability without the Alma API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authoritative bib + real-time availability reads for a leading academic LSP.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Alma API key scoped to the institution. Bib metadata is non-PII; user/loan endpoints are separate.

candidates.intent: Retrieve a patron's loans/requests/fees via the Ex Libris Alma Users & Fulfillment API.
candidates.input_contract: user_id plus resource (loans | requests | fees), paging
candidates.output_contract: loan/request/fee records with item, due_date, status, amounts
candidates.source_name: Ex Libris Alma REST API (Users & Fulfillment)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a patron's real loans, holds, or fines without the Alma Users API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative patron circulation data for library-service workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Patron borrowing records are sensitive (library-privacy laws + FERPA in academia) — minimize, review-gate, no retention.

candidates.intent: Retrieve a bibliographic instance (with holdings/items) from the open-source FOLIO LSP inventory.
candidates.input_contract: instance id or CQL query against /inventory/instances
candidates.output_contract: instance record with identifiers, holdings records, items, status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read a FOLIO library's live inventory without an authenticated tenant token.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated reads of real catalog inventory for an open-source library platform.
candidates.verify_note: FOLIO mod-inventory is Apache-2.0 open source; tenant data is private (Okapi token + tenant header). Inventory is non-PII; patron modules separate.

candidates.intent: List Springshare LibGuides research guides and assets via the LibGuides CMS API (LibApps).
candidates.input_contract: site id + optional status/expand params (pages, assets)
candidates.output_contract: guide objects with id, name, url, owner, type, last_updated
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate a library's published research guides without the LibGuides API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative library research-guide listings for discovery and reference workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Requires LibApps API credentials. Guide content is institutional/public-facing; low PII.

candidates.intent: Search scholarly works and retrieve citation metadata by query or DOI via the Crossref REST API.
candidates.input_contract: query terms or DOI plus filters (type, from-pub-date), rows/offset
candidates.output_contract: work items with DOI, title, authors, container-title, issued date, reference list
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve a real DOI's authoritative citation metadata or verify a reference without the live index.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds keyless lookups of real DOIs and citation metadata for plagiarism/citation-checking and bibliography building.
candidates.verify_note: No API key required; metadata is largely not copyrighted. A polite-pool mailto is recommended. Non-PII scholarly metadata.

candidates.intent: Retrieve full metadata for a single DOI via the Crossref REST works/{doi} endpoint.
candidates.input_contract: a DOI string
candidates.output_contract: work record with title, authors, ISSN/ISBN, publisher, license, funders, references
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably produce a correct, verifiable citation for a given DOI from memory.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative per-DOI metadata to ground citations and detect fabricated references.
candidates.verify_note: Keyless; deterministic per-DOI lookup ideal for citation verification. Non-PII.

candidates.intent: Retrieve a Duolingo learner's language progress (skills, streak, XP) via the unofficial API.
candidates.input_contract: username (and authenticated session for private data)
candidates.output_contract: user object with languages, skill tree state, streak, XP, league
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a learner's actual Duolingo progress or streak without querying the service.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds reads of real language-learning progress for tutoring/nudge workflows.
candidates.verify_note: UNOFFICIAL/undocumented API (https://www.duolingo.com/api/1) — brittle, ToS-risky, may break without notice; learner PII. Candidate only; verify current behavior before any use.

candidates.intent: Translate text between languages for language-learning content via the DeepL API.
candidates.input_contract: text[] plus source_lang/target_lang and optional formality
candidates.output_contract: translations[] with detected_source_language and translated text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: While models translate, a bare model gives non-deterministic, unversioned output without quality SLAs or glossary control.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a governed, glossary-controlled translation service with consistent output for language-learning material.
candidates.verify_note: Requires DeepL API key. Translation is inherently non-deterministic — treat output as proposal, not verified truth; glossary improves consistency.

candidates.intent: Search Open Educational Resources (OER) by subject/grade/standard via the OER Commons API.
candidates.input_contract: query plus filters (subject, education_level, material_type, standard)
candidates.output_contract: OER records with title, provider, url, license, alignment, description
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate currently-available, license-tagged open educational resources without the live API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds discovery of real OER with explicit licenses and standards alignment for course building.
candidates.verify_note: Per-resource license varies (CC etc.) — preserve license metadata; API access terms apply. Low PII.

candidates.intent: Search MIT OpenCourseWare / MIT Open Learning Library courses and materials via the MIT Open API.
candidates.input_contract: query plus filters (department, level, resource_type)
candidates.output_contract: course/material records with title, url, instructors, topics, license
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate MIT OCW's current open courses/materials and their CC licenses without the live catalog.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds discovery of real open courseware (mostly CC BY-NC-SA) for self-study curricula.
candidates.verify_note: Platform code is open (mitodl); content licenses are mostly CC — preserve license/attribution. Verify current MIT Open API host/endpoints before use.

candidates.intent: Search the edX/2U course catalog (programs, courses, runs) via the Course Catalog API.
candidates.input_contract: query plus filters (org, subject, availability), paging
candidates.output_contract: course/program records with key, title, org, runs, marketing_url
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate edX's current catalog of courses/programs and runs without the live API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds discovery of real MOOC offerings with current run dates for learning-path planning.
candidates.verify_note: Requires edX OAuth client. Catalog data is largely public/marketing; low PII.

candidates.intent: Retrieve Khan Academy's topic/content tree and exercise metadata via the (legacy) Khan Academy API.
candidates.input_contract: topic slug or content kind plus optional depth
candidates.output_contract: content nodes with id, kind, title, slug, children, content_url
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably enumerate Khan Academy's current content hierarchy or exercise ids without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds structured discovery of real K-12 learning content for curriculum mapping.
candidates.verify_note: Khan API is legacy/partially deprecated — verify which endpoints remain live before use; content is largely public. Candidate only.

candidates.intent: Retrieve a learner's VitalSource e-textbook entitlements and reading data via the VitalSource API.
candidates.input_contract: user/credential scope plus optional book SKU filter
candidates.output_contract: license/book objects with SKU, title, format, access status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a student's actual e-textbook entitlements or access without the platform API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authoritative reads of digital course-materials entitlements for access workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Requires VitalSource API credentials. Entitlements tie to identifiable learners — FERPA-relevant.

candidates.intent: Configure or read LockDown Browser / Respondus Monitor settings for an exam (LMS integration).
candidates.input_contract: exam/quiz id plus LockDown/Monitor settings payload
candidates.output_contract: applied exam-integrity settings and Monitor session config
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enforce assessment-integrity browser lockdown or webcam monitoring on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides deterministic exam-integrity configuration tied to an LMS assessment.
candidates.verify_note: Monitor records webcam/behavior of students — high privacy/consent/FERPA sensitivity; integration is LMS-mediated, not a broad public API.

candidates.intent: Retrieve K-12 roster/enrollment data from Infinite Campus SIS via OneRoster/Campus APIs.
candidates.input_contract: OneRoster resource (users/classes/enrollments) or Campus API path plus filters
candidates.output_contract: student/teacher/section/enrollment records per OneRoster schema
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read a district's authoritative Infinite Campus roster without the SIS API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds standardized reads of real K-12 rosters from a major SIS via OneRoster.
candidates.verify_note: Authoritative minor PII from the SIS of record — FERPA/COPPA-critical; district-approved OAuth2 scopes; minimize + review-gate.

candidates.intent: Read normalized district roster data via the ClassLink Roster Server (OneRoster) API.
candidates.input_contract: OneRoster endpoint (orgs/users/classes/enrollments) plus filters and OAuth2 creds
candidates.output_contract: OneRoster-shaped roster objects (users, classes, enrollments)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read normalized cross-SIS K-12 rosters without a rostering aggregator like ClassLink.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a normalized OneRoster read across heterogeneous district SIS systems for provisioning.
candidates.verify_note: Aggregates minor PII across districts — FERPA/COPPA-critical; tenant-scoped OAuth2; minimize, no retention, review-gate.

candidates.intent: Read unified rostering/grades/assignments across many LMS+SIS via the Edlink Graph API.
candidates.input_contract: Edlink integration token plus resource (people, classes, enrollments, sections)
candidates.output_contract: normalized objects spanning Canvas/Schoology/Classroom/Clever/etc.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read a single normalized view across the fragmented LMS/SIS landscape without an aggregator.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds one normalized API over many education systems, reducing per-vendor integration cost.
candidates.verify_note: Aggregates education PII across vendors — FERPA/COPPA; per-integration OAuth scopes; minimize + review-gate.

candidates.intent: List discussion topics for a Canvas course or group with posting/lock state.
candidates.input_contract: course/group id plus optional order_by, scope, search_term
candidates.output_contract: DiscussionTopic objects with id, title, message, posted_at, locked, reply counts
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a course's live discussion threads or their state without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative discussion content for facilitation and summary workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Canvas token. Student posts are identifiable speech — FERPA; don't expose across cohorts.

candidates.intent: List files in a Canvas course/folder with metadata and download URLs.
candidates.input_contract: course/folder id plus optional content_types[], search_term
candidates.output_contract: File objects with id, display_name, content-type, size, url, locked
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate or fetch a course's actual file assets without the Files API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides authoritative access to real course materials for content workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Files may include student-submitted content + instructor IP — FERPA + copyright; review-gate downloads.

candidates.intent: List rubrics for a Canvas account or course and their criteria/ratings.
candidates.input_contract: account/course id plus optional include[assessments]
candidates.output_contract: Rubric objects with id, title, criteria[] (description, points, ratings)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a course's actual grading rubrics or point breakdowns without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative rubrics to ground consistent, criteria-based grading assistance.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Canvas token. Rubric definitions are course-owned; low PII unless assessments included.

candidates.intent: Retrieve learning outcomes and outcome groups for a Canvas account/course.
candidates.input_contract: account/course id plus outcome group navigation
candidates.output_contract: Outcome objects with id, title, description, mastery points, ratings
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know an institution's defined learning outcomes or mastery thresholds without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative outcomes for competency mapping and accreditation reporting.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Canvas token. Outcome definitions are institutional; low PII. Outcome RESULTS are FERPA-sensitive.

candidates.intent: Submit a SIS import (CSV) to provision/update Canvas courses, users, and enrollments (write).
candidates.input_contract: account id plus SIS CSV payload and import_type
candidates.output_contract: SisImport object with id, workflow_state, progress, processing_warnings/errors
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot bulk-provision Canvas users/courses/enrollments by itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides a deterministic, auditable bulk-provisioning path with error reporting.
candidates.verify_note: Bulk mutation of identities/enrollments — very high blast radius; approval-gate; PII-heavy CSV must be governed. FERPA-critical.

candidates.intent: Fetch quizzes for Moodle courses via mod_quiz_get_quizzes_by_courses.
candidates.input_contract: array of courseids
candidates.output_contract: quiz objects with id, name, timeopen, timeclose, grade, attempts allowed
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a Moodle course's quizzes or open/close windows without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative quiz settings for assessment scheduling and integrity checks.
candidates.verify_note: Requires WS token with mod_quiz capability. Quiz questions are exam-integrity sensitive.

candidates.intent: Retrieve Moodle forum discussions and posts via mod_forum_get_forum_discussions.
candidates.input_contract: forumid plus optional sort/paging
candidates.output_contract: discussion objects with id, subject, message, user, timemodified, replies
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read a Moodle forum's live discussions without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative forum content for facilitation and summarization.
candidates.verify_note: Forum posts identify learners — FERPA; don't expose across cohorts; review-gate.

candidates.intent: List Blackboard course content items (folders, documents, links) via the Contents REST API.
candidates.input_contract: courseId plus optional parent contentId, paging
candidates.output_contract: content objects with id, title, contentHandler, availability, position
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate a Blackboard course's actual content structure without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns the authoritative content tree for navigation and content-management workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Blackboard OAuth2. Content is course-owned IP; attachments may include student work (FERPA).

candidates.intent: List Schoology assignments for a section (containers for coursework and tests).
candidates.input_contract: section_id plus paging
candidates.output_contract: assignment objects with id, title, due, type, max_points, grading_period
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot know a Schoology section's assignments or due dates without the API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns authoritative assignment definitions and deadlines for planning workflows.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Schoology OAuth1. Assignment content is section-owned; due dates low PII.
